resources.string: Shows when this device is relaying SMS for AutoTranslator.

An Administrator registers this device from the AutoTranslator dashboard (Settings → Channel integrations → Android SMS gateway) and is shown a one-time device token. Paste that token below — this app never registers itself.
By continuing, you agree that text messages sent to and from this phone will be relayed through your organization\'s AutoTranslator inbox for translation and staff visibility.

This gateway sends and receives SMS on your organization's behalf, so Android requires explicit permission for each of the following:

• Send SMS — to deliver outbound replies
• Receive SMS — to relay inbound messages
• Phone state — to pick the correct SIM on dual-SIM phones and detect signal loss
• Notifications — required to show the persistent "gateway running" notice
Disconnected — this device has been revoked. Contact your administrator to re-register it.

This device needs to stay reachable at all times to relay SMS reliably. Manufacturer battery savers (Samsung Device Care, Xiaomi MIUI battery saver, Huawei Protected Apps, OnePlus Battery Optimization, etc.) can pause this app even after granting the exemption below — check your phone manufacturer\'s own battery settings and allow this app to run unrestricted / without restrictions.
